items.caption: A modern stroke-order rendering of 哪 shows 口 on the left and 那 on the right.
items.alt: A sequence of 哪 characters, with colored marks showing the strokes in order.
items.selection_reason: It clearly shows the present-day graph and its two visible components, which helps illustrate the usual structural analysis. It does not show an ancient form or establish the graph’s history.

limitations.text: No verified ancient or manuscript form of 哪 is shown. Later lexicographic testimony says the graph was originally 那, but does not establish a dated sequence of forms or when 哪 first appeared.
